items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I called Dave Duncan in Ponca City and asked him to come join the band.

ctx.x: And so Dorsey, that all came about after the Gladewater deal, and then Dave Duncan then, something when I came back, my mind told me, now you're trying to build this band, you need an arranger all the time in there. I called Dave Duncan in Ponca City and asked him to come join the band.
